posts.text:
Monday, Nov 2: Toronto's streetcars lost 876 hours to delays, across all routes.

Hardest hit: 501 Queen westbound, where the typical trip lost 29 min.
Smoothest: 507 Long Branch eastbound, 11 min.

https://freems88.github.io/ttc-streetcar-delays/

Monday's slowest spot: Northbound on Dundas St West, approaching Bloor St West.
The average streetcar lost 1 min 58 s here. Across 275 trips, that adds up to 9.0 hours.
This signal has transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of Dundas St West around Bloor St West, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the northbound stretch at Bloor St West is highlighted, peaking at about 1 min 58 s lost per streetcar.

shot.title: Dundas St West northbound, approaching Bloor St West
shot.sub: Monday, Nov 2: 1 min 58 s lost per streetcar · 275 trips

posts.text:
Monday, Nov 2: bunching and missing cars added 1.4 min to the average wait at a stop on frequent routes.

Worst: 511 Bathurst southbound, 3.0 min extra; 1 in 7 cars bunched.
Steadiest: 509 Harbourfront eastbound, 0.3 min extra.

https://freems88.github.io/ttc-streetcar-delays/#v=wait

Most held at a signal, Monday, Nov 2: eastbound at Fort York Blvd & Fleet St.

1 in 3 streetcars waited 90 s or more beyond a clean approach, about a full signal cycle, despite transit priority.
About 278 streetcars came through.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Fort York Blvd & Fleet St, with arrows for each direction of streetcar travel into each signal, coloured by how often streetcars were held 90 seconds or more. A tooltip for the eastbound approach reads 34% held 90 s+, with a histogram of extra time through the approach.

posts.text:
Monday, Nov 2: at the busiest moment (6:20 pm), 152 streetcars were in service, against 151 scheduled.
Overall, 100% of scheduled streetcar service ran, and buses ran 1,057 hours on streetcar routes.

Service changes, Monday, Nov 2:
• 501 Queen, partly by bus: Route change
• 504 King, partly by bus: Temporary service change due to City of Toronto work
• 506 Carlton, partly by bus: Detour via Dundas St W and Spadina Ave due to…
